visualCharacteristics: Full-width 16:9 photo with a white box overlaid bottom-left holding a condensed headline; whole block links to the headline URL; on mobile the box sits below the image

contentPattern.rows: Row 1: image. Row 2: H2 headline, linked to the destination page.
contentPattern.structure: row 1 holds the image; row 2 holds the H2 headline, linked to the destination page

usage.description: Lead promo at the top of the homepage (e.g. 'Pumpkin Recipes That Are Perfect in Every Way').

reuseGuidance: Use for a single lead promo where a large photo carries a short linked headline in a white box. Keep the headline short (two lines at 450px). For a promo with a description or CTA, use columns-promo instead.
